description.value:
A creature within range is bathed in radiation and must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d10 necrotic damage and gaining one level of exhaustion for the duration on a failure, or half the damage and no exhaustion on a success. An exhausted target may attempt a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the power on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot of 3rd level or higher increases the damage by 1d10 for each slot level beyond 2nd.
